title: Brassinosteroid-associated transcriptional regulatory networks in rice.
authors: Zhu, Ruolan; Yu, Qian; Yang, Long; Gao, Xiuying; Huang, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合多组学数据并利用机器学习预测水稻BR相关转录因子靶标，构建基因调控网络，虽涉及TF-DNA靶标预测但缺乏三维互作建模与机制研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作课题。
abstract: Brassinosteroids (BRs) are crucial in regulating growth, development, and environmental adaptation in plants. To understand the complex regulatory network of BRs, we integrated RNA-Seq, sRNA-Seq, and degradome data from rice (Oryza sativa L.) seedlings subjected to brassinolide (BL) treatment and from BR core signaling gene mutants (qgl3, osgsk3, and osbzr1). Using guide-gene-directed network construction and machine learning-based transcription factor (TF) target prediction methods, we also constructed BR-associated gene coexpression and regulatory networks. This study revealed synergistic regulation at the transcriptional level between BR core signaling mutants and BL treatment, highlighting the central modules involving qGL3 and OsGSK3 in BR signaling. The constructed regulatory network was enriched for TFs centered on the qGL3/OsPPKL1-OsGSK3-OsBZR1 pathway. Potential BR-core TF genes were identified using coexpression and regulatory network analyses, and their loss-of-function mutants were evaluated using BL sensitivity assays and immunoblot analyses. Additionally, a BR transcriptional regulatory network database was developed, providing a valuable resource for the rice BR research community.
abstract_zh: 油菜素甾醇（Brassinosteroids, BRs）在调控植物生长、发育及环境适应中至关重要。为理解BRs复杂的调控网络，我们整合了来自水稻（Oryza sativa L.）幼苗经油菜素内酯（brassinolide, BL）处理及BR核心信号基因突变体（qgl3、osgsk3和osbzr1）的RNA-Seq、sRNA-Seq和降解组数据。利用引导基因导向的网络构建和基于机器学习的转录因子（transcription factor, TF）靶标预测方法，我们还构建了BR相关基因共表达和调控网络。本研究揭示了BR核心信号突变体与BL处理在转录水平上的协同调控，突出了BR信号中涉及qGL3和OsGSK3的中心模块。构建的调控网络富集了以qGL3/OsPPKL1-OsGSK3-OsBZR1通路为中心的转录因子。通过共表达和调控网络分析鉴定了潜在的BR核心转录因子基因，并使用BL敏感性测定和免疫印迹分析评估了其功能缺失突变体。此外，开发了一个BR转录调控网络数据库，为水稻BR研究社区提供了宝贵资源。
